entries.6e790ec49e3e1394: The group has formulated its 8th Medium-Term Management Plan, and aims to become a distinctive and unique company with high agility and flexibility that supports the infrastructure functions of the securities and financial markets as Japan's only securities finance company, while maintaining high financial soundness and achieving sustainable growth and enhancement of corporate value. As strategies, it lists six priorities: stable operation and improved convenience of margin transaction operations; expansion of security finance operations centered on further strengthening security lending; enhancing presence and recognition in overseas markets; business innovation and operational efficiency through the use of digital technology; strengthening consolidated group management; and strengthening the foundation of human capital.

entries.7889a6e21ba33ae4: It accepts cash and shares as collateral and lends government bonds through bond repo and gensaki transactions; conducts share repo transactions, in which it accepts shares held by financial institutions and others as collateral and lends cash in return; conducts general share lending, in which it procures shares from institutional investors and lends them to securities companies; and also conducts general credit financing and securities-collateralized loans for retail customers.
entries.87f861e9a0e47cfb: Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥114,211 million (up 92.0% year on year).
entries.9fec0fef8b1108a4: The company is Japan's only securities finance company, supporting the infrastructure functions of the securities and financial markets. Under the provisions of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act, it holds a license from the Prime Minister for margin transactions, and by lending funds and shares required for systemized margin trading to securities companies, it contributes to the smooth circulation of shares and proper price formation. In addition, it conducts risk management that limits the expansion of net exposure through margin calls in line with the market value of collateral and by setting collateral haircuts according to the magnitude of fluctuations in the shares subject to transactions.
entries.aa13fb15e35f57cd: Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥114,211 million (up 92.0% year on year). Against a background of firm stock market conditions and increased funding demand due to rising market interest rates, margin transaction operations and stock repo transactions performed firmly. By business, the securities finance business was ¥102,945 million, the trust banking business ¥10,520 million, and the real estate leasing business ¥745 million.
